english_title: Recognising and Responding to Saying Sorry
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: greetings & basic social contact — saying sorry
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to saying sorry; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan apologises to Ms Emma for not having the book with her today.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan xin lỗi chị Emma vì hôm nay không mang theo sách.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: I am sorry, Emma. I do not have the book today.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Emma. Hôm nay tôi không mang sách theo.

turns.speaker: Ms Emma
turns.vietnamese: Ai cũng có lúc như vậy mà.
